variants.prompt: Photorealistic portrait of an alluring woman reclining on a plush, crimson velvet chaise lounge in the candlelit intimacy of an opulent boudoir, raven-black hair spilling across the silk duvet, emerald-green eyes sparkling with intrigue as she gazes directly at the camera, porcelain skin glowing in the warm, diffuse light filtering through gauzy drapes, a delicate necklace of pearls adorning her slender throat, the rich velvet of her coat and cream blouse barely visible beneath the lavish bed linens, captured in a shallow focus against a blurred backdrop of ornate antiques and velvet drapes, evoking a sense of private, forbidden indulgence.
